body: Decision 0383 review LOW. internal/gitstatus/status.go:405 (classSplitIndex) is unreachable for a real split-index repository: Git's ls-files probe fails first with a MetadataProbeError, which maps to unclassified. conformance/mcp-2026-07-28/reason_class_test.go (TestReasonClassUnclassifiedToolError) and internal/gitstatus/status_test.go:141 pin that outcome. An agent on a split-index repository gets unclassified although the enum has split-index.
